games.title: FloppyBird
games.tagline: Flap the disk. Beat the gates.
games.description: Guide a winged floppy disk through a bright field of moving towers in a responsive Three.js run built as its own workspace.
instructions: Press Spacebar, click, or tap to flap upward from the ready state.
Stay centered and clear each glowing gate to score one point per passed obstacle.
The host HUD and overlays stay in the DOM so status, pause, and game-over states remain accessible.

games.title: Neon Drift
games.description: A self-contained Three.js workspace that keeps the original neon-drift energy while swapping raw WebGL for a smoother linked scene.
instructions: Watch the ship carve through the lane grid while boost pulses sharpen the light trails.
This placeholder showcase still mounts through the same host contract, HUD, and pause-resume lifecycle as the playable games.

games.title: Orbital Stack
games.description: A compact Three.js workspace that keeps the original orbital-stack prototype energy while moving it into the shared lazy-loaded runtime.
instructions: Tap or click to add another glowing plate to the orbital tower.
This showcase workspace keeps score in the shared HUD and respects the host pause-resume lifecycle.
